title: רב חמא בר טוביה

paragraphs: Rav Chama bar Tuvya erred in two matters in Arba Mitot, Sanhedrin 52b: he used bundles of branches to burn a priest's daughter who had committed illicit intercourse, whereas such cases are judged only when the Chamber of Hewn Stone is functioning, and [burning is performed] with a wick of lead. He was among the later amoraim. Perhaps Chilkiyah was his brother.
